Typing streams made of public words only (the dictionaries the program ships with and a few phrases, typed in the right and the wrong layout), and what the last Python build (0.66.2) did with each word: `rows-public.json.gz` without Hunspell, `rows-public-hunspell.json.gz` with the en_US and ru_RU Hunspell dictionaries `model/intent_v1/config.json` pins. `battery.rs` types them through this engine and compares every word, the second with `--speller`.
